priorities.summary: A use-after-free in MongoDB Server's replication code can be triggered by unauthenticated requests when a newly elected replica set primary completes catch-up, crashing the server or possibly running code in the server process. Fixed releases are out for all supported branches — upgrade every replica set member to 9.0.7, 8.3.16, 8.0.37, 7.0.48, 6.0.30, 5.0.35 or 4.4.32.
priorities.plain: MongoDB Server lets anyone on the network crash database servers during a failover, and possibly run code; upgrade every replica set member now.

priorities.summary: Quay builds a database search pattern from user-controlled namespace names without escaping wildcard characters, so an attacker who creates a namespace containing an underscore can match and retrieve other tenants' robot accounts and their decrypted authentication tokens. Red Hat has released fixed Quay versions — upgrade to a patched release.
priorities.plain: Red Hat Quay lets an attacker who creates a specially named account read other customers' private container login tokens; upgrade Quay now.

priorities.summary: Incorrect authorization in Chrome's FileSystem lets a remote attacker who tricks a user into visiting a crafted page run code outside the browser sandbox. Google fixed it in Chrome 157.0.8103.78 — update Chrome now.
priorities.plain: Google Chrome lets a malicious web page break out of the browser's safety sandbox and run code on your computer; update Chrome now.

model.name: Gemini 4 Hydrogen
model.summary: Google's fast new Gemini 4 model for everyday coding and agentic work, completing tasks about 2.5x faster than Gemini 3.8 Flash — now the default model in Search's AI Mode, the Gemini app and AI Studio.
model.plain: A faster, cheaper everyday AI model from Google that handles coding and multi-step assistant tasks, now built into Search and the Gemini app for every user.
